Name: Dog Bandana
Author: JamieDepledge
Description:
This mod exists because dogs are always 150% cuter with bandanas wrapped around their necks. 

Does nothing except add a cute little bandana to the vanilla dog sprite.

Because CUTENESS!

Colours Available: Red, Blue, Green, Purple.

[b]MORE COLOURS WILL BE ADDED OVER TIME! REQUESTS OR IDEAS WELCOME![/b]

How to install.
1. Backup your dog.xnb file that already exists in your \Stardew Valley\Content\Animals folder.
2. Download the file and unzip it.
3. Replace your old dog.xnb with the new one.
